title: Consent terms v1
description: One person's consent to a data commons, in machine-readable form. Designed to travel with the data: any recipient can check a request or a use against it. Pseudonymous: contains no name, phone number or address.

subject_ref.description: Random pseudonym. Never a name, phone number or ID number.

language.description: BCP-47 code of the language the person read: en: English | pcm: Nigerian Pidgin | yo: Yorùbá

notice.description: Which exact wording was shown: SHA-256 of the canonical notice text, and whether its translation was reviewed.

purposes.description: Deny by default: anything not in allowed is denied. service_improvement: Improving the community mental-health service the person uses | public_health_research: Non-commercial public-health research on youth mental health | policy_statistics: Anonymous totals for policy, planning and advocacy | ai_training_noncommercial: Training or testing open, non-commercial AI tools for mental-health support | ai_training_commercial: Training or testing AI products sold for profit

allowed.description: service_improvement: Improving the community mental-health service the person uses | public_health_research: Non-commercial public-health research on youth mental health | policy_statistics: Anonymous totals for policy, planning and advocacy | ai_training_noncommercial: Training or testing open, non-commercial AI tools for mental-health support | ai_training_commercial: Training or testing AI products sold for profit

denied.description: service_improvement: Improving the community mental-health service the person uses | public_health_research: Non-commercial public-health research on youth mental health | policy_statistics: Anonymous totals for policy, planning and advocacy | ai_training_noncommercial: Training or testing open, non-commercial AI tools for mental-health support | ai_training_commercial: Training or testing AI products sold for profit

data_categories.description: usage_metadata: When and how often the service was used (no message content) | demographics: Age range, gender and state (no name, phone number or address) | screening_scores: Answers to wellbeing check questions, such as mood scores | chat_transcripts: What the person typed in chats, with names and numbers removed | voice_audio: Voice notes

permitted_users.description: commons_stewards: The commons team itself | nigerian_public_researchers: Universities and public-health researchers in Nigeria | international_academic: Universities outside Nigeria | nonprofits: Non-profit organisations | government_health: Government health agencies | commercial: Companies that make money from products

deidentification.description: Minimum protection required. deidentified: Record-level, with names, numbers and addresses removed | aggregated_only: Only totals and averages, never individual records

cross_border_transfer.description: May the data be stored or used outside Nigeria?

required.description: A request must commit to ALL of these to include this person. results_back: Results returned to the community in plain language | open_access: Findings published free for anyone to read | community_credit: The community is credited (acknowledgement or co-authorship) | community_fund: A share of funding or revenue goes to a community fund | local_capacity: Paid training or jobs for local researchers or health workers

collected_via.description: How the consent was collected. Informational only; changes no rule. Known values: web_chat_demo: The person used the consent chat themselves (web demo) | assisted_offline_demo: A community health worker took the person through the chat on a shared device (demo label: offline storage and later sync are not built) | synthetic_seed: Generated synthetic example person

synthetic.description: True for demo data. Real deployments set false.
